_comment: Leak/stealer fan-out POLICY (case_state.leak_selectors / leak leads, run by enrichment_run — the case_enrich tool). Every CONFIRMED selector of a case (an analyst seed, an owner-rung typed node, a WHOIS registrant email/phone of a host within max_owner_hop of the seeds, an owned seed domain, a social-intake account username) is checked against every leak vendor its TYPE supports. Kit- and neighbour-rung selectors (co-tenants, shared-kit hosts, exchange counterparties) are NEVER leak-checked. Results are EXPOSURE facts, never attribution edges. `{v}` in argv is replaced by the selector. A vendor row with `na` is a static not-consulted reason; `via` means the row is read from another vendor's step (deep_profile already sends Hudson Rock + IntelX for an email, so they are never bought twice).

selection._comment: max_owner_hop: registrant contacts are taken only from hosts at hop <= this (0 = seeds, 1 = first-round owner links). username_regex: a seeded string/handle that is shaped like an account username.

vendors._comment: Vendor columns of the per-selector coverage table, in report order.

plan._comment: type -> vendor -> {op, argv[, key]} | {via} | {na}. op is an enrichment_run SCRIPTS op; key overrides the default leak:<vendor>:<type>:<v> lead key so an identical existing lead (email-deep:, cld-phone:) is shared, never re-run.

intelx.na: IntelX refuses soft selectors — a username is not a strong selector

hudsonrock.na: Cavalier v3 has no phone endpoint
